title: Extreme Cold
description: Plain-text guide to recognizing and treating hypothermia and frostbite following CDC and AHA first aid, plus wind chill and who is most at risk. Covers dressing in layers, staying warm without heat, surviving if stranded in a vehicle or caught outside, and a winter car kit.
shortDescription: Hypothermia and frostbite first aid, staying warm, and surviving a stranded car
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
